title: Brooklyn building collapse: 1 dead, at least 9 injured as rescue continues - ABC7 New York
description: A partial building collapse in Flatbush has left at least one person dead, and at least 10 injured as firefighters continue efforts to search for others who may be trapped.

title: United Airlines bans AI agents from booking flights on behalf of travelers - CBS News
description: Using an artificial intelligence agent to make flight reservations poses security risks and could violate federal rules, according to United.

title: SS United States live updates: How to watch intentional sinking of historic vessel off Florida coast - 6abc Philadelphia
description: SINKING AN ICON: The SS United States is embarking on its final voyage Wednesday as the historic ocean liner heads to its final home on the floor of the Gulf, off Florida's Panhandle coast.

title: Pete Hegseth and others reprimanded by guard at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier - NBC News
description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth was reprimanded Wednesday by an Army sentinel guarding the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier who asked him and his guests to maintain “atmospheric silence and respect.”

title: Live updates: Democrat Scott Colom will win a US Senate seat in deep-red Mississippi, CNN projects - CNN
description: Colom will unseat GOP incumbent Cindy Hyde-Smith, becoming the first Black person elected to statewide office in Mississippi since the Reconstruction era. Follow for the latest.
